basic_details.job_title: ICDS Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the pay, the application fee or the selection process.

how_to_apply: Submit the online application between 16 November 2026 and 30 November 2026.
Do not send an offline application, or one by post or courier, because these are not valid.

For the required documents and the conditions of appointment, see the website or the notice boards of the Integrated Child Development Project Office Darima Ambikapur-2 and Janpad Panchayat Ambikapur.

rows.details: Integrated Child Development Project Darima Ambikapur-2

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The Anganwadi Centre Taparkela-02 comes under the Integrated Child Development Project Darima Ambikapur-2 in Ambikapur, Chhattisgarh. The notice was issued through the Chhattisgarh public relations news service and quotes the Project Officer. Detailed information is available at the project office and the notice board of Janpad Panchayat Ambikapur.

content_sections.heading: Integrated Child Development Project Darima Ambikapur-2 Anganwadi Sahayika Important Dates
content_sections.text: The online application window had not yet opened on 13 November 2026, the date of the notice.

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: The notice announces one vacancy in total. It is at Anganwadi Centre Taparkela-02. Category-wise reservation is not printed.

rows.project: Integrated Child Development Project Darima Ambikapur-2

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Gender: only women candidates (महिला अभ्यर्थी) can apply. Age: between 18 and 44 years. The notice does not print an age cut-off date or any relaxation. Residence: the applicant must live in the Gram Panchayat in which the vacant Anganwadi centre is located. This is mandatory. The notice does not state the educational qualification; check the official website https://aww.e-bharti.in/ and the notice boards of the project office and Janpad Panchayat Ambikapur for the eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Integrated Child Development Project Darima Ambikapur-2 Anganwadi Sahayika
content_sections.text: Open the departmental website https://aww.e-bharti.in/ . Submit the online application between 16 November 2026 and 30 November 2026. Do not send an offline application, or one by post or courier, because these are not valid. For the required documents and the conditions of appointment, see the website or the notice boards of the Integrated Child Development Project Office Darima Ambikapur-2 and Janpad Panchayat Ambikapur.

faq.question: Q1. How many Anganwadi Sahayika posts are vacant at Darima Ambikapur-2?
faq.answer: One Anganwadi Sahayika post is vacant, at Anganwadi Centre Taparkela-02.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Anganwadi Sahayika post?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026. Applications open on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Anganwadi Sahayika at Darima Ambikapur-2?
faq.answer: The applicant's age must be between 18 and 44 years.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Anganwadi Sahayika post?
faq.answer: Apply online on the departmental website https://aww.e-bharti.in/ between 16 November 2026 and 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Can men apply for this Anganwadi Sahayika post?
faq.answer: No, the notice invites only eligible women candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Do I have to live in a particular village to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the applicant must live in the Gram Panchayat where Anganwadi Centre Taparkela-02 is located.

faq.question: Q7. Are applications by post or courier accepted?
faq.answer: No, applications are accepted only online. Offline applications, and those sent by post or courier, are not valid.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I get the required documents and appointment conditions?
faq.answer: They are available on https://aww.e-bharti.in/ and on the notice boards of the Integrated Child Development Project Office Darima Ambikapur-2 and Janpad Panchayat Ambikapur.
